jobs.occupation: Associate Partner and Competence Team Lead, Operational Transformation, Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Are you motivated by the opportunity to deepen your leadership, commercial and advisory impact while contributing to sustainable growth in the operational transformation area? As Associate Partner and Competence Team Lead for Valcon’s Operational Transformation team, you will play a key role in developing our people, strengthening client partnerships and evolving our capabilities. And you will be instrumental in growing the area considerably in the future matching Valcon’s growth ambitions.

Role and profile

The job is located at the intersection between client delivery, team leadership, commercial work and service offering development.

You will lead a team of approximately 12 consultants and help shape the continued development of our Operational Transformation offerings, focused on Process Redesign and Process Automation, including agentic automation. You are expected to support the further integration of AI, data and technological capabilities into the services based on a clear understanding of our clients’ business needs and strategic ambitions. The ideal candidate brings deep experience and insight from both operations’ excellence and business process redesign as well as technology-driven business change and automation.

You will also act as a trusted advisor to clients, and contribute to Valcon’s growth by being commercial active, building trusted client relationships and lead projects that deliver sustainable results.

To thrive in this role, you have demonstrated experience in these four competence areas:

• Team leadership: Guide, inspire and develop a talented team of consultants, fostering an inclusive environment where people can thrive, collaborate effectively and deliver meaningful results together

• Commercial growth: Strengthen Valcon’s position as a trusted advisor by building long-term client partnerships and creating sustainable growth opportunities together with clients

• Client engagement: Manage and deliver complex projects with high-quality standards from initial mobilization to final delivery and further expansions

• Service development leadership: Develop internal capabilities and strengthen methodologies with AI, data, and technology as key enablers of business transformation

The role offers a high degree of autonomy and responsibility. The ability to balance time between all four areas is key, as they are equally important for success in this role.

In addition, you should embody these skills:

• People skills: Build and nurture existing relationships and teams through empathy, engagement and effective communication with clear direction

• Business and digital acumen: Think analytically and strategically with a pragmatic approach to execution. View AI, data and digital technology as integral elements of modern business development

• Subject-matter-expertise: Business process redesign, improvement and automation

• Education: Speak and write English fluently and professionally, with Danish being a plus. Completed relevant higher education or equivalent professional experience. Further education is a plus

Organisation and reporting

You will be the direct people manager of the Operational Transformation team of consultants (excluding Associate Partners and Partners) or managing their people managers. The role reports to a Partner from either one of our Commercial Sectors or our Head of Consulting.

Location and travel

The role is based at Valcon’s offices in central Copenhagen or Århus, Denmark. You can expect travel in connection with client meetings and project work, primarily within the Nordic region.

About Valcon

We are a European powerhouse in AI and data-driven business transformation, bringing this to life by integrating management consulting with data and digital technology capabilities.

We ensure companies are in their best possible shape – fit for the future. We spot opportunities and help bring them to life. We are thorough, fast and collaborative in everything we do. From the boardroom to the shop floor. From strategy to operations.

We are a no-nonsense consultancy with curious individuals who are driven by creating value together with clients. We have an informal culture and a flat hierarchy with offices in Denmark, Sweden, the Netherlands, the UK, Germany, Croatia and Serbia.

Career opportunities

Valcon is in a significant growth phase supported by acquisitions and capital investment from Rivean Capital and Waterland Private Equity. This supports our ambitious expansion plans – both geographically and in terms of capabilities – with a particular focus on the Nordics and the DACH (German-speaking) region. Therefore, you will have a unique opportunity to help shape the company’s development and gain strategic influence over its future direction.

The role provides internal career development opportunities toward broader leadership roles within the capability or across the broader organisation. With Valcon’s international footprint and focus on complex transformation projects in the business and technological space, you will gain access to:

• A broad network of colleagues and clients across Europe

• Strategically significant and high-complexity projects

• Opportunities to work with cutting-edge technology, including AI, data and digital technologies

Application

If this role sounds like a good match, we warmly encourage you to apply and share how your experience, strengths and perspective could contribute to the team. Deadline for applications is Monday December 7, but we do review applications on an ongoing basis.

**Minimum qualifications:

**

• Bachelor's degree in Network Engineering or Telecom Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 3 years of experience fiber types and their application, physical fiber characteristics, and standard testing tools (e.g., Optical Spectrum Analyzer (OSA), Bit Error Rate Tester (BERT), Optical Time Domain Reflectometer (OTDR)).

• Experience in telecommunications, carrier class optical network infrastructure, transmission systems, layer2/3 routers, and data services.

**Preferred qualifications:

**

• Experience with managing or directing field operation technicians, engineers, contractors or vendors in a Telco working environment.

• Experience in developing and implementing automation solutions for network deployment or similar processes.

• Experience with process improvement or process engineering methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma).

• Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, lead technical projects, prioritize and manage project timelines.

• Ability to travel up to 50% as necessary.

• Strong investigative and problem-solving skills, with a focus on data-driven decision-making.

About the jobAs a Network Implementation Engineer, you will be the initial point of our efforts to execute deployment, maintenance, and operations of private data networks worldwide. You will work with Technical Program Managers, Network Engineers, Design and Infrastructure Engineers, Field Engineers within Google, as well as construction and telecommunications vendors and contractors, all to position your team and organization for success.

You will facilitate faster, better, and more efficient, positive outcomes for the business and our customers. Your objective will be to build the world’s most reliable, cost-effective and scalable network to support all of our current and future customers and users globally.Google's network provides services to millions of Internet users around the world. Our metros are on the edge of our network where Google connects to its users. The Network Team is responsible for operating that network reliably and at scale. Our team owns the full life-cycle of all space, power, and network assets in all of Google’s data centers and metro points of presence globally. From the foundation, we are involved from site acquisition to construction and are accountable for what space and power is delivered. We're involved in every facet of network delivery from architecture and design to installation, configuration, activation, and commissioning. Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Denmark: kr.800000 - kr.820000 (DKK) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

**Responsibilities

**Learn more about benefits at Google .

• Deliver Google's network reliably and at scale, with a focus on workflow automation and efficiency.

• Drive adaptable and scalable approaches, collaborating with cross-functional teams to optimize network deployment cycle time and operational costs through process improvements.

• Manage an area of responsibility, addressing issues, anticipating needs and escalating as necessary, while identifying automation opportunities to improve efficiency and prevent reoccurring failure modes.

• Maintain accurate network data to drive operational excellence.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

We are looking for:

Steel Fitters

Key tasks:

Your job as steel fitter will be responsible for assembling, positioning, aligning, and fitting structural steel components to create frameworks for buildings, bridges, ships, and heavy machinery.

 Your key responsibilities & duties will include:

·         Blueprint Interpretation: Study engineering drawings, blueprints, and material lists to plan the sequence of tasks and determine material requirements.

·         Layout and Fabrication: Layout reference points and patterns on heavy metal to prepare for cutting, bending, and forming.

·         Assembly and Fitting: Assemble, align, and fit metal sections and plates to form complete units or subunits, using tack welding, bolting, or riveting.

·         Machine Operation: Operate heavy-duty machinery such as cranes, shearers, brake presses, grinders, drills, and cutting torches to prepare components.

·         Quality Inspection: Inspect and test completed components to ensure they meet specifications, quality standards, and safety regulations.

·         Positioning and Installation: Position parts in jigs (sometimes created by tack-welding scrap metal) and use grinders, chisels, or files to ensure precise fits.

·         English - must be able to communicate in English 

·         Technical Knowledge: Proficient in reading blueprints and technical drawings.

·         Fabrication Skills: Experience (good to have) with metal fabrication techniques, including tack welding, oxy-acetylene cutting, and operating shop machinery.

·         Mathematical Skills: Strong understanding of shop math for measuring, layout, and calculations.

·         Physical Demands: Ability to perform physically demanding work, including standing for long periods, bending, lifting heavy loads, and sometimes working at heights.

·         Safety Adherence: Strict compliance with occupational health and safety (OHS) standards and proper use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).

jobs.occupation: Engineer with Administrative Background and interested in Aviation.
jobs.description:
AIR ALSIE A/S is a Danish aviation company headquartered in Sønderborg, Denmark. Our core business activities include flight operations, business aviation charter services and aircraft maintenance.

AIR ALSIE A/S is Scandinavia’s largest regional airline within the business aviation segment, and we are experiencing rapid growth and continuous development. As our organisation continues to expand, we are looking to strengthen our Technical Engineering team with a dedicated and skilled professional.

The Position

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Engineer or Aircraft Technician with a strong administrative mindset and an interest in aviation regulations and compliance.

The ideal candidate combines technical knowledge of aircraft maintenance with strong administrative skills and an understanding of regulatory requirements. You will play an important role in supporting and developing our technical organisation, ensuring that documentation, procedures and processes meet applicable aviation standards and regulatory requirements.

This position offers an exciting opportunity to work across technical and administrative functions, collaborate with colleagues throughout the organisation and contribute to the continued development of AIR ALSIE A/S.

Are you passionate about aviation and motivated by being part of a dedicated team working towards shared goals? Do you want to take responsibility, make a difference and contribute to the future development of AIR ALSIE A/S? Then we would like to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities

• 
Manage, maintain and update technical documentation and records in accordance with applicable aviation regulations and authority requirements.

• 
Maintain and update the Maintenance Organisation Exposition (MOE), ensuring continued compliance with relevant regulatory requirements.

• 
Establish and maintain effective communication and cooperation with aviation authorities.

• 
Coordinate and collaborate with internal departments on matters relating to flight operations and aircraft maintenance.

• 
Support the development and implementation of improvements to aircraft maintenance processes, procedures and working methods.

• 
Assist in the planning and coordination of aircraft maintenance programmes and resource allocation.

• 
Support the development and maintenance of employee training, competency and qualification programmes.

• 
Contribute to ensuring a high standard of regulatory compliance and operational efficiency across the organisation.

Your Profile and Qualifications

We are looking for a structured and proactive individual who enjoys working with both technical matters and administrative tasks.

Ideally, you bring:

• 
An educational background in aircraft engineering, aircraft maintenance or a related technical field, combined with administrative experience.

• 
Experience with aircraft maintenance procedures, processes and practices.

• 
Knowledge of aviation regulations, compliance requirements and industry standards.

• 
Strong organisational skills and a structured approach to documentation and administrative tasks.

• 
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across departments.

• 
Proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

• 
The ability to work independently, prioritise tasks and maintain an overview in a dynamic working environment.

• 
A solution-oriented mindset and the ability to handle challenges efficiently.

• 
An aircraft maintenance licence, certification or other relevant professional qualifications will be considered an advantage.

What We Offer

At AIR ALSIE A/S, you will become part of an ambitious and growing aviation company where your contribution matters.

We offer:

• 
An exciting position in a dynamic and developing aviation industry.

• 
A varied role with a combination of technical, administrative and regulatory responsibilities.

• 
Opportunities for professional development, further training and relevant certifications.

• 
A collaborative and supportive working environment with highly skilled and dedicated colleagues.

• 
The opportunity to influence processes and contribute to the continued development of our technical organisation.

• 
Competitive salary and employment conditions in accordance with your qualifications.

A Great Place to Work

At AIR ALSIE A/S, we believe that our employees are our greatest asset. We offer an informal working environment characterised by mutual respect, strong teamwork and a high level of professional expertise.

We strive to create an inspiring workplace where employees are encouraged to take responsibility, share their knowledge and continuously develop their skills and talents.

Our continued growth and success are driven by the commitment, expertise and dedication of our employees. We believe in working together, supporting one another and creating an environment where everyone has the opportunity to make a difference.

Would you like to be part of our journey?

We look forward to welcoming a new colleague to the AIR ALSIE team!

Visit our website www.alsie.com to read more about our company.

Questions

If any questions, feel free to contact Maintenance Manager Torsten Plank Lorentzen TPL@alsie.com or by phone +45 74429888.

Does This Sound Like the Right Opportunity for You?

If you recognise yourself in the profile described above and are motivated to take on the role of Engineer or Aircraft Technician at AIR ALSIE A/S, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Please submit your motivated application, CV and relevant educational certificates through our website at www.alsie.com.

Application deadline: 1 December 2026

We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis and interviews will be conducted throughout the application period. The position will be filled as soon as we find the right candidate.

Please use the reference “Engineer or Aircraft Technician – 2026” when submitting your application.

We are looking for someone who can join our team as soon as possible, or by mutual agreement.

Interviews will take place at our offices in Sønderborg, Denmark.

We look forward to receiving your application and hopefully welcoming you to the AIR ALSIE team!

jobs.occupation: Tech Lead, Video Conferencing & Screen Sharing
jobs.description:
Most companies that do conferencing hand you one slice of it. The desktop app, or the media pipeline, or, maybe, the join flow. Everything else you pass over a wall to another team. Not in this case. One team owns the whole path across the Airtame platform: Airtame 3, Airtame Go, Virtual Airtame, and browser, desktop, and mobile apps that go with them. The bar remains at an effortless experience. Someone walks into a room, and starts sharing. No app to hunt for, no login to chase.

The team is four engineers, and we're hiring their technical and people lead: someone who spends about 60% of time hands-on with the hardest problems, and the rest growing the engineers around them.

**About Airtame

**We're around 55 people, headquartered in Copenhagen, and you'd work from there or remotely from within the EU. We make the hardware and the software that runs on it, so a call you make about the streaming stack ends up in a product bolted to a wall in meeting rooms around the world. The team is small, works across disciplines, and reaches a global market from a small base.

Year one outcomes

Make joining a call one step that works. Today, getting an authenticated meeting started from a room takes too many turns: personal logins, manual entry, a different quirk on every platform. A year from now, starting a scheduled call on Teams, Zoom, Google Meet, or Webex should be something a room just does. Judge it by how often it works on the first try, and how rarely it reaches support.

Take the friction out of screen sharing. The browser path loses first-time users: too many clicks, not enough signposting. You'll own getting a newcomer from a short code to their screen on the wall without a stumble, and getting Miracast and AirPlay stable enough to turn on by default.

Make it behave the same everywhere. The experience varies between Airtame 3, Virtual Airtame, browser, desktop, and mobile today. By year-end, sharing and calling should feel like one product no matter which surface you're on, with real-time quality that holds up on whatever network the room happens to have.

Lead the team. You'll run the 1:1s, set the technical bar, and support team members' growth. The measure is simple: a year in, the team runs on your leadership day to day.

Push AI-assisted development further. The team already builds with AI daily. You'll lead the next step: sharper workflows, better tooling choices, new patterns that make the whole group faster. By year-end, the team's AI practices should be visibly ahead of where they started.

Who you are

• The player-coach. You've owned a team's technical direction: the architecture calls, the reviews where the hard problems get caught. And you want the people side too. Growing engineers, running 1:1s, hiring. You're not looking to trade one for the other. Maybe you've been a staff engineer or tech lead ready to own a team, or a manager who never stopped building. Either way, 60/40 sounds about right to you.

• Comfortable across the stack. Real-time media is second nature to you: WebRTC, streaming, the way audio and video behave over a network you don't control. You've gone deep somewhere, whether a media pipeline, native protocols, or a cross-platform client, and you can hold your own everywhere else, on browser, desktop, and mobile.

• You've made stubborn systems cooperate. Half this job is getting software to play nicely with platforms you don't own: Teams, Zoom, Meet, Webex, the operating system's own media APIs, each with its own idea of how things should go. You've done that kind of integration, and you keep your head when every platform behaves differently.

• You measure yourself by the room. Your bar is the person standing at the "share" button. Someone who's never seen an Airtame, getting their screen up first try with no help. That's what you optimize for, and it steers the calls you make when something has to give.

• You use AI as a daily tool. You write code with it, debug with it, prototype with it. You've formed your own view on where it speeds things up and where it gets in the way, and you help the people around you do the same.

**Logistics

**Location: Remote in Europe, or hybrid from our Copenhagen office.

Employment type: Full-time preferred. We're also open to a project-based contract scoped to delivering the native protocol implementations.

****Why Airtame:

• The defining calls are still ahead. Airtame's collaboration software keeps spreading across more devices and form factors, so the shape of the next phase is still open, and you'd be the one setting it.

• At our size, a major call you make shows up in front of customers within weeks, so the feedback comes back fast.

• A healthy work-life balance.

• Significant responsibility and ownership over projects and your field of expertise.

• Five weeks paid vacation and 5 days of extra paid AirtameFlex days.

• Flexible work environment, with a hybrid mindset.

• Pension and private health insurance (on FTE Copenhagen contract).

Airtame is an equal opportunity employer. We have colleagues across the globe, with both in-office and full-time remote workers. This feeds into our international hybrid mindset, with people from 25+ nationalities that make up the Airtame team.

Our work-life cultural balance is key to our success. Our team encompasses our values of trust and open communication to support each other and to collaborate in a fun and collective way.

****What Our Employment Decisions Are NOT Based On

****Race, colour, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, disability, ethnicity, national origin, marital status, family or parental status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected classification or status. And we will not tolerate discrimination or harassment.

****What Our Employment Decisions ARE Based On

****Business needs, job requirements, individual qualifications, and candidates potential for growing with Airtame.

****How We Handle Your Application Data

****Airtame ApS (CVR 35478973, Copenhagen), together with Airtame US Inc. for US roles, processes the information you submit to assess your application. We do this under the EU General Data Protection Regulation, wherever you are based. Your data is stored in Greenhouse, our recruiting system, which may store it outside the EU under standard EU safeguards. Only the people involved in hiring can see it. For roles with privileged access to our systems, we’ll contact one professional reference or previous employer that you name, to confirm your role and dates. We’ll tell you before we do. We keep your data for 6 months after the recruitment process ends, or longer where US law requires it or where you consent to us keeping it for future roles. To get a copy of your data, correct or delete it, or object to how we use it, write to data@airtame.com. You can also complain to the Danish Data Protection Agency (Datatilsynet).

****What Our Employment Decisions ARE Based On

****Business needs, job requirements, individual qualifications, and candidates potential for growing with Airtame.

**Principal Embedded Engineer, AI Solutions

****Position Overview

**Autodesk Technical Advisory is seeking a highly technical and customer-focused Embedded Engineer, AI Solutions to join our new Embedded Engineering (forward-deployed engineering) team.

You will work directly alongside strategic Autodesk customers to discover high-value workflows, model the data those workflows depend on, and build the AI systems for their Design & Make workflows to enable customer’s measurable business outcomes.

You will move fluidly from understanding a customer's workflow and architecture to writing code. You will spend your weeks writing production code to build agents and orchestration, retrieval and graph services, connectors and APIs - inside customer environments, alongside customer engineers. What you ship is concrete: AI agents, MCP servers and tools, domain and semantic models, knowledge-graph extensions, retrieval and context-resolution pipelines, integrations into ERP, PLM, BIM, enterprise data platforms, and eval harnesses to move new capabilities into production.

Unlike traditional project delivery, Embedded Engineering works deeply inside customer environments, connecting Autodesk technology and data with the rest of the enterprise. Insights developed through customer work will be translated into reusable agents, connectors, reference architectures, engineering patterns, and direct product feedback that shapes Autodesk's platform roadmap.

The successful candidate combines strong software and AI engineering skills with curiosity, customer empathy, business judgment, and the ability to operate independently when the problem is not yet well defined. This role is engagement-driven with travel up to 75% during active engagements, including extended periods working onsite with customers.

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.

**Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed below.

**Responsibilities

****Discover Workflows and Own the Outcome

**

• Partner with customer executives, business leaders, and technical teams to translate transformation objectives, operational KPIs, sustainability commitments, and digital initiatives into measurable, AI-enabled workflow outcomes.

• Lead co-innovation with customers to find high-value workflows, decision bottlenecks, data requirements, and integration opportunities, turning ambiguous business challenges into clear technical directions.

• Analyze end-to-end workflows across Autodesk and non-Autodesk systems to pinpoint friction, process inefficiency, data gaps, and the places where AI and agents genuinely change the economics.

• Own technical execution end-to-end - rapid prototype through architecture, build, integration, testing, governance, production deployment guidance, and adoption - with accountability for customer impact.

• Sequence the work and decide what not to build. Make explicit trade-offs between scope, speed, and durability, and defend them to both customer and Autodesk stakeholder

**Make Data and Context AI-Ready

**

• Assess customer data readiness - fragmented sources, ownership, quality, lineage, metadata, governance, permissioning, and integration constraints - required to support trusted AI and agentic workflows.

• Structure and connect design intent, project, product, and asset data, along with requirements, supporting evidence, approvals, decisions, and dependencies, into trusted AI-ready data and context models that enable reasoning, retrieval, and agentic action.

• Design ontologies, semantic layers, and knowledge graphs that business users recognize and agents can act on, including entity resolution across source systems, schema mapping, and permission models that survive contact with enterprise reality.

**Build and Ship Production AI

**

• Design and build production-grade AI-enabled workflows, agents, applications, and integrations that connect Autodesk products and platform capabilities with customers' broader enterprise technology environments.

• Build the retrieval and context layer these systems depend on - hybrid search, graph-grounded retrieval, tool interfaces, and MCP servers that expose governed enterprise context to agents safely.

• Make quality measurable. Build evaluation harnesses, golden datasets, guardrails, tracing, and observability so that agent behavior is testable before launch and monitored after it, and so that quality regressions and drift are caught in production rather than reported by users.

• Apply strong engineering practices across architecture, code quality, security, permissions, reliability, observability, testing, performance, and maintainability, adapting quickly to complex and constrained customer environments.

• Define the operating model for what you build - runbooks, ownership, escalation, and cost - and hand it over cleanly to customer teams or Autodesk services so value persists after the engagement ends.

**Feed the Product and Build Reusable IP

**

• Act as a frontline product discovery mechanism, translating customer learning into prioritized product requirements, platform capability gaps, roadmap recommendations, and opportunities for feature or API acceleration.

• Convert customer-specific learning into reusable Autodesk value - reference architectures, agent and MCP patterns, connectors, ontology templates, graph models, reusable code, evals, and technical playbooks - that reduces the cost of every engagement that follows.

**Build an AI-Native Practice

**

• Design, build, and operationalize the agents, workflows, and automations that make the Embedded Engineering organization itself faster and more effective, measuring success by both customer impact and scalable internal leverage. Continuously look for manual work to replace with agentic systems and reusable internal tooling.

• Stay at the frontier. Maintain working knowledge of new model capabilities, agent implementation patterns, and AI product development stacks, and bring what's genuinely useful into practice.

• Serve as a trusted technical advisor across the boundary - partnering with customer engineers, architects, and business leaders, and with Autodesk Sales, Customer Success, Technical Advisory, Product, and Platform teams - to unblock delivery and help teams navigate ambiguity, trade-offs, risk, and changing requirements.

**Minimum Qualifications

**

• 6+ years building and operating production software, including 2+ in a customer-facing or embedded role (forward-deployed or founding engineer). CS/Engineering degree or equivalent hands-on experience.

• Full-stack range. Expert Python plus one of TypeScript, Java, or C# - comfortable across backend, data pipelines, integrations, and a lightweight React surface when a workflow needs one.

• Cloud fluency in Azure or AWS: containers, serverless, managed data stores, and identity and networking inside customer-governed environments (e.g., infrastructure as code with Terraform, Bicep, or CloudFormation), with strong API, distributed-systems, CI/CD, and observability fundamentals.

• Agentic systems in production. You've built and run single- and multi-agent systems - tool schemas, memory, human-in-the-loop checkpoints - on a modern orchestration framework (e.g., LangGraph, LangChain, Bedrock AgentCore, etc), MCP making practical cost and latency trade-offs (e.g., model selection, caching).

• Evaluation as engineering. You build golden datasets and eval harnesses from real customer data, and you measure groundedness, task success, and retrieval quality using standard tooling (e.g., RAGAS, LangSmith, Langfuse).

• Retrieval and data readiness. You've built retrieval systems end-to-end (chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, reranking) over a vector store and can assess and fix messy enterprise data - lineage, permissions, entity resolution, schema mapping.

• Knowledge architecture for AI. You model domain semantics into AI-ready context - ontologies, semantic layers, knowledge graphs - and ground agents in it via GraphRAG or equivalent, using at least one graph technology (e.g., Azure Cosmos DB Gremlin, Amazon Neptune, Neo4j, or equivalent) and its query language (e.g. Gremlin, Cypher, SPARQL).

• Ownership under ambiguity. You take greenfield customer problems from framing to production and measured outcomes and can explain a non-deterministic system with equal credibility to an engineer and an executive.

**Work arrangement

**

• You'll work with one customer at a time on focused engagements, for specified duration, on-site at customer locations that may be outside your home country, with travel of up to 75%, subject to any immigration or other requirements (averages likely to be lower across the whole year). You remain an Autodesk employee throughout, and the intention is that Autodesk's policies, benefits, and time off apply on every assignment. Some customers may have their own onboarding, safety, security or other requirements, which will be discussed with you at the time.

**Preferred Qualifications

**

• Domain fluency in AECO, with the ability to ramp quickly on design-to-construction-to-operations processes.

• Autodesk platform fluency: Autodesk Platform Services (APS), AEC Data Model API, Autodesk Construction Cloud and Common Data Environment (CDE) concepts, Forma, Fusion, Flow, and Autodesk data models.

• Enterprise systems of record integration: ERP, PDM, PLM, BIM, project controls, cost, scheduling, and asset management, plus enterprise data platforms (data lakes, warehouses, Lakehouse, analytics platforms).

• Constrained enterprise deployment: customer VPCs, private, on-prem, or air-gapped environments, data residency and sovereignty requirements, SSO/SCIM, and formal security review processes.

• AI-native builder practice: routine use of AI coding agents, harnesses, and automation to multiply individual and team throughput, including spec-driven development: writing clear specs and executable acceptance criteria for coding agents, keeping changes small and reviewable, and verifying AI-generated code through automated tests and review.

• Production trust and safety: prompt-injection defense, permission-aware retrieval, provenance and audit trails, versioning, staged rollout, monitoring, and incident response.

**Ideal Candidate

**

• Ships. Has put things into production and can name the metric that moved.

• Treats evaluation as part of the product. Assumes agents will fail and builds evaluation, observability, and guardrails before scaling.

• Is fluent in both worlds. Understands the customer’s business process and the failure modes of non-deterministic systems.

• Thinks in reusable patterns. Instinctively asks, “How does this become an asset for the next ten customers?”

• Moves fast without leaving a mess. Knows when speed matters, when engineering rigor matters, and how to make that trade-off deliberately.

Do you want to lead the team that keeps Systematic applications running around the clock, while developing a team of 12–14 specialists and bringing Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices into their daily work?

The job

You will lead the Application Operations team in Customer Operations and report to the Director of Customer Operations. Your role combines classic operations with the growth of our cloud offering, so you will balance daily delivery with building something new. You will also take on a growing responsibility for handling security incidents in cooperation with our security lead.

In short, you can look forward to:

• Leading and mentoring 12–14 team members through regular 1:1s and performance reviews

• Supporting incident response and coordinating deployment schedules and change management

• Introducing SRE practices such as SLOs, error budgets, blameless post-incident reviews and toil reduction

• Driving automation, capacity planning and operational KPIs together with development and infrastructure teams

• Managing the team budget, time registration and on-call payout calculations

Joining the team

Our site reliability engineers (SREs) work with system administration, DevOps support, monitoring and technical support to the business units, and we run in a 24/7 environment with rotating on-call schedules. You will work closely with development teams, infrastructure teams and customer support, so that solutions like Columna stay available for the clinicians and care staff who depend on them every day.

Your qualifications

• 7–10 years of experience in application operations, system administration, DevOps or SRE roles either as a technical profile or a manager.

• 3–5 years of experience leading technical teams

• Experience being responsible for technical deliveries with full ownership of operations and management responsibility

• Commercial understanding of contracts, budgets, and service and delivery agreements

• Experience negotiating service agreements with internal business units as a professional partner

• Experience handling security incidents and helping business units restore services quickly

• Experience with high-availability, 24/7 operational environments

• Proficiency with monitoring and observability tools, and experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP)

• Understanding of containerisation and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines

• Proficiency with ITIL or similar operational frameworks, and a solid understanding of SRE principles

Your everyday job will have many contact point with people inside and outside the department so we are looking for a manager with a extrovert personality who is keen to create strong relationships.

You look beyond your own department and understand how Systematic's business works, and you turn strategy into action while explaining it clearly to others. You balance technical depth with the overview a manager needs, and you are comfortable taking calculated commercial risks.

Part of the role is to grow our cloud offering and make it clear and easy to communicate, and you stay committed for the long term, from the first launch to stable daily delivery. You lead through influence and expertise, you explain technical topics to non-technical stakeholders, and you stay calm during incidents.

jobs.occupation: Senior Offshore Wind Turbine Loads & Structural Dynamics Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

Are you passionate about understanding how offshore wind turbines respond to the forces of nature? Do you want to use your engineering expertise to influence the design, performance and long-term reliability of offshore wind farms?

At Vattenfall, we believe there is a way to build a more sustainable energy future. We're looking for a Senior Offshore Wind Turbine Loads & Structural Dynamics Engineer to join our Structural Loads team within Offshore Engineering.

In this specialist role, you'll work at the heart of offshore wind turbine engineering, using engineering analysis, aeroelastic modelling and measurement data to investigate complex turbine behaviour and turn the results into sound engineering decisions.

From early development and turbine selection through to operational optimisation and lifetime extension, your expertise will help shape important technical decisions across our offshore wind portfolio.

You'll join an international team of engineering specialists who value collaboration, technical excellence and finding practical solutions to complex challenges.

Your Role

As a Senior Offshore Wind Turbine Loads & Structural Dynamics Engineer, you'll combine hands-on technical expertise with responsibility for delivering complex engineering work across offshore wind projects and operating assets.

Working closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, turbine manufacturers and external partners, you'll help ensure our offshore wind turbines are designed and operated safely, efficiently and reliably.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Advanced engineering analysis: Independently define, perform and technically own aeroelastic load analyses, including modelling strategy, execution, validation and interpretation, turning complex results into sound engineering conclusions and decisions.

• Structural integrity: Assess wind turbine and support-structure loading and independently investigate and resolve complex engineering questions relating to fatigue, structural performance and lifetime extension.

• Project delivery: Technically lead load-related engineering activities, ensuring technical deliverables meet project requirements, quality standards and deadlines, and act as the Structural Loads technical point of contact for assigned projects.

• Technical collaboration: Work closely with specialists across Wind Turbine Engineering, Primary Structures, Geotechnical Engineering and Metocean to solve multidisciplinary engineering problems where turbine loads, structural response and environmental conditions interact.

• Stakeholder engagement: Act as a trusted technical partner to internal stakeholders, understanding their needs and translating complex loads-related questions, risks and results into clear engineering recommendations that support project decisions.

• Innovation and improvement: Develop and refine simulation models, engineering tools and analysis methods to improve turbine performance, reduce technical risks and support continuous improvement.

Your Profile

We're looking for an experienced engineering specialist who can independently investigate and solve complex engineering problems, translating detailed analysis into well-founded engineering conclusions and practical solutions.

You'll bring a strong understanding of wind turbine aeroelasticity and structural dynamics, alongside the ability to take technical ownership, exercise sound engineering judgement and communicate complex technical matters clearly and effectively across different disciplines.

Qualifications

• A master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Wind Energy or a closely related discipline.

• At least 7 years of relevant industry experience in wind turbine aeroelasticity, load simulation or structural dynamics.

• Extensive hands-on experience defining and performing aeroelastic load analyses, including model development, simulation, validation, post-processing and interpretation of results.

• Strong knowledge of wind turbine aerodynamics, structural dynamics, control systems and load-generation mechanisms.

• Experience interpreting simulation results, validating engineering models and working with measurement data.

• Experience working within multidisciplinary engineering environments, ideally within offshore wind, turbine manufacturing or renewable energy development.

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical findings and collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.

• Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

It would also be beneficial if you have experience in:

• Offshore wind turbine foundation design, hydrodynamics or coupled turbine-foundation analysis.

• Relevant IEC and DNV standards and certification processes.

• Engineering programming tools such as Python or MATLAB.

• Operational load assessments, turbine power upgrades or lifetime extension projects.

Above all, you'll bring curiosity, a careful and structured approach to engineering challenges, and a genuine interest in sharing knowledge and developing solutions together.

Additional Information

Our offer

Good remuneration, a challenging and international work environment, and the possibility to work with some of the best in the field. You will be working in interdisciplinary teams and you can always count on support from committed colleagues. We offer attractive employment conditions and opportunities for personal and professional development.

More Information

We welcome your application in English, no later than 02/12/2026. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website as we cannot guarantee that we will be able to process applications that are not made via our website.

For more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our recruiter Adam Hammond via adam.hammond@vattenfall.com

Commitment to Diversity

Vattenfall is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive community - a place where we can all be ourselves and succeed on merit. We offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, staff engagement forums and services to support all our employees.

We are convinced that diversity contributes to build a more profitable and attractive company and we strive to be good role model regarding diversity. Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Company Description

Vattenfall is a European energy company with around 20,000 employees. For more than 100 years, we have powered societies and industries through innovation and collaboration. Today, we are focused on enabling a more sustainable energy system and supporting the transition to cleaner ways of living.

Business Area Wind is responsible for Vattenfall’s Onshore and Offshore Wind as well as other non-hydro Renewable activities like solar PV and batteries. Today we develop, construct and operate wind generation in Sweden, Denmark, Germany, the Netherlands and the UK. In addition, we have a clear strategy to develop our solar PV and battery operations further.
